title: Lookahead-then-Verify: Reliable Constrained Decoding for Diffusion LLMs under Context-Free Grammars
reasoning: The paper focuses on improving the syntactic and functional correctness of diffusion large language models (dLLMs) through a novel constrained decoding approach called LAVE. It evaluates the method on technical tasks like code and JSON generation and does not involve any evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, ethics, or morals.
